about: Worked out with WoWSims Forever's own Stat Weights tool (wowsims.com/forever/hunter/dps, game 1.60.1.70938, site built 2026-11-15), since its hunter sim ships no weights. Set up with its BM preset (talents, rotation, buffs) and its own P1 gear set (ui/specs/hunter/dps/gear_sets/p1.gear.siml, imported as SIML), 25,000 iterations, reference stat Agility. DPS EP as the tool shows it, Agility = 1; '1%' rows are per 1%. Run in John's Chrome on 14 Nov 2026 (US Central); John: 'i feel we should be accurate as this dictates what a player will want to roll for'.
